item.title: Trump says US 'doing very well' in Iran nearly 1 week into joint action against Tehran
item.summary: President Trump says Iran's military is "gone" nearly a week after the U.S. and Israel started coordinated military action against Tehran.

item.title: Man convicted of Iran-backed Trump assassination plot compared his plan to Butler shooting: FBI
item.summary: Asif Merchant told an FBI agent he thought Iran "was responsible" for the assassination attempt on President Trump in Butler, Pennsylvania, but the bureau found no evidence of that.

item.title: Video captures chaos erupting at NYC vigil for slain Ayatollah Khamenei as punches fly
item.summary: Violence erupted at a Washington Square Park vigil for deceased Iranian leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, as a man was punched for attempting to tear down a poster.

item.title: US military carries out targeted strike on alleged narco-terrorist network in Ecuador
item.summary: The U.S. military conducted a targeted strike against a narco-terrorist network in Ecuador in a joint operation with Ecuadorian forces, SOUTHCOM officials said.

item.title: Dem Sen Peter Welch praises Trump's 'respected' pick to replace Noem at DHS, says 'he'll be confirmed'
item.summary: Vermont U.S. Sen. Peter Welch says Markwayne Mullin will be confirmed as DHS secretary, calling Trump's nominee "honest" and "competent" compared to Kristi Noem.

item.title: Biden says ‘I’m a h--- of a lot smarter than most of you’ to crowd at Jesse Jackson's funeral
item.summary: Joe Biden shared a personal story about childhood stuttering at Jesse Jackson's memorial service, telling a crowd he's "smarter than most of you" in a pointed comment.

item.title: Trump admin hits back at ex-California mayor's call for federal guaranteed income as cities hand out cash
item.summary: Michael D. Tubbs, founder of Mayors for a Guaranteed Income, advocated for federal cash assistance, but the Trump administration opposes such initiatives as unnecessary handouts.

item.title: Raiders trade Maxx Crosby to the Ravens for two first-round draft picks
item.summary: Las Vegas Raiders trade Maxx Crosby to Baltimore Ravens for two first-round picks including No. 14 overall pick in upcoming NFL draft ahead of free agency.

item.title: California Rep. Darrell Issa to retire, endorses Jim Desmond to succeed him
item.summary: California Rep. Darrell Issa announces retirement after 25 years, endorses San Diego County Supervisor Jim Desmond for newly redrawn 48th District seat.

item.title: SJSU and CSU suing federal government over Title IX investigation into transgender volleyball scandal
item.summary: San Jose State University President Cynthia Teniente-Matson announced the school is suing the federal government over its Title IX violation determination.
